nextjs-to-tauri 1.1.4

- Updated skill trigger keywords in the description for broader context detection (e.g. 打包成桌面应用 / 迁移到 Tauri).
- Added metadata to declare Node.js binary as a requirement.
- Improved TypeScript type annotation in the Next.js config sample to prevent type widening errors.
- Clarified image/icon requirements and updated icon generation instructions (e.g. 1024x1024, directory removals).
- Enhanced notes on file organization by recommending a dedicated frontend desktop integration folder.
- Removed unused or redundant documentation file (skill-card.md).

- Removed unused skill-card.md file to clean up the repository.
- Updated SKILL.md and tauri-files.md for clarity and accuracy.
- No functional changes to scripts or migration procedure.
- Minor maintenance release.

nextjs-to-tauri 1.1.0

- Improved version management: now injects the git tag into package.json on tag push, making the tag the single source of truth and aligning versions for releases and updates.
- Clarified CI process by specifying that installer filenames and app versions are now derived from the pushed git tag, preventing silent upload failures.
- Updated documentation with new guidance for version handling and gotchas, especially regarding correct tag/version synchronization.
- Removed skill-card.md for a more focused documentation set.

nextjs-to-tauri v1.0.0

- Initial release: Guide for converting a Next.js 16 (App Router) app to a Tauri 2 desktop app.
- Covers static export packaging, auto-update setup, language persistence, window state, single-instance, system tray, and CI builds with GitHub Actions.
- Includes migration gotchas for next-intl i18n, updater signing keys, and build/version coordination.
- Provides step-by-step procedure with template scripts, configuration, and integration files.
